title: Outstandingly Sweet Norwegian Cod Skewers
description: A sweet and springy Norwegian dish perfect for a date night, featuring white chocolate and a Whole30-friendly twist, with a deglaze for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut sugar, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the Norwegian cod pieces to the bowl and marinate for 10 minutes.
Thread the marinated cod pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through.
While the cod is cooking, melt the white chocolate chips in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the cod is cooked, brush the melted white chocolate over the top of each skewer.
Deglaze the saucepan with a little water to remove any remaining white chocolate and pour over the skewers.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
